_template: BLANK TEMPLATE — copy to run-metadata.json and fill. Do not fill this file in place.
_rules: null means NOT YET ESTABLISHED. Leave it null rather than guessing — an empty field is evidence that something could not be determined, a guessed one is not.
Every field below is recorded BEFORE extraction runs.
Delete the keys beginning with an underscore from the filled copy.

drawing._note: SYSTEM-GENERATED from the uploaded file. The user supplies the file; they do not type an identifier. OWNER DECISION D17: identity is CONTENT identity — drawingId derives from sha256, never from filename, upload event or folder structure, because the same evidence must not create multiple drawing identities. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: see BLOCKED.md, adopting it as written breaks facilityOf(), which reads the site out of the id string.

pages._note: pageCount is DETECTED, never asked for. selection is the user's, and it is the one page-related thing the system may not decide: NEVER INFER WHICH PAGE CONTAINS THE TARGET ROOM. If the user selects no page, every page is analysed and reported separately — the engine does not pick the one that looks like a dialysis room.
pages._selectionMode: 'user-selected' or 'full-document'. Nothing else. There is no 'auto' — that would be the inference the rule forbids. IMPLEMENTED: verify:drawing --all-pages (or supplying no page) runs full-document; --page N or --pages N,M records a selection; an out-of-range page is REFUSED, never clamped. A refusal is a third outcome and analyses nothing.
pages._selectedPages: Zero-based. Null when selectionMode is 'full-document'. The first page is 0, not 1 — a page number off by one resolves to a real but different sheet, producing a record that is valid and false.

catalogue._note: There is no single repository-wide catalogue version. Record the `version` of every equipment record the run uses, one entry each.

ruleSet._note: ruleSetId and ruleSetVersion appear on the evaluation report. status is expected to be 'draft' — every dialysis rule currently carries source.document: null (A-1).

scoringModel._note: RefWithVersion from standards/scoring/. minimumCoverage is recorded because it decides whether a total is offered at all.

code._note: THE FULL 40-CHARACTER COMMIT SHA. There is no SOLVER_VERSION constant in this repository, and none of the version fields below changes when solver logic changes — so the SHA is the only complete identifier of the code that produced this result. A shortened SHA is not sufficient for a record intended to be re-run against.

execution._note: ISO-8601 with offset, in the operator's own timezone — not UTC-only. A hand-converted wrong time is a valid-but-false record.

context._note: OPTIONAL metadata. A run proceeds without any of it. Optional means ABSENT — omit the key rather than writing 'unknown', 'system', 'TS team' or a role name. NEVER INFER REQUESTER IDENTITY. An absent key says nothing; a placeholder says something false, which is owner decision D14's principle applied to people instead of frequencies.

reviewingEngineer._note: NOT AN INPUT FIELD. Required only at the human review confirmation stage, and recorded there — in review/ and confirmation/, not here. Left null through the whole machine run. NEVER INFER REVIEWER IDENTITY, and never fill this from a role: a confirmation's `name` must identify an individual.
reviewingEngineer.recordedAt: review/ and confirmation/, after the machine run stops

geometry._note: THREE TIERS, NEVER COLLAPSED. Recorded by hand: boundarySchema and spaceSchema carry no provenance field, so the document model cannot distinguish tier 1 from tier 2 for SHAPE. Scale is different — calibration.method does distinguish them. See PILOT_VALIDATION_PROCESS.md §3.

drawingEvidence._note: TIER 1 — read from or referenced in the drawing. Not verified by anyone yet.

verifiedGeometry._note: TIER 2 — confirmed by human input. Every entry must name WHO confirmed it and AGAINST WHAT. An entry without both is tier 1 wearing a tier 2 label, which rule 3 forbids.

evaluationGeometry._note: TIER 3 — what the solver actually used. THE CHECK: every value here must trace to tier 1 or tier 2. A value tracing to neither was inferred, and rule 2 forbids inferring a dimension from visual appearance.

rulesObserved._note: Answer each as observed during the run, not as intended before it.

expected._note: Recorded in advance so the run cannot be re-described afterwards by what it produced. These are consequences of A-1 being unresolved, not predictions of success.
expected.clearanceFindings: RC-110 throughout — no threshold to compare against
